ns2:course.label: Fin Atg Reporting Standards
ns2:course.description: Current authoritative accounting standards and applications to accounting practice. Topics do not represent the full range of financial reporting issues, but are selected based on relevance of the underlying business transaction, complexity of the topic, consistency of applicable standard with underlying reporting concepts, and transferability of the standard to other accounting issues. This course is for students in the Certificate in Accountancy program. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ACCY 303 or consent of department.
